string.text: Who are you... And what the fuck is a girl like you doing down here?!
No, I haven't "found any". Are you off your mind, bitch? You gotta hear the growls coming from down there first, then you can think about treasures.
Shit... I don't know, girl... I don't want to see those damn things ever again...\n...
You're completely crazy, bitch. You know that? Good luck with your search.
I don't have time for your crap, cunt.

Sis, I don't know what to say, honestly. We can finally leave this shithole. I'm going back to Sultan with these documents, the boys here will stay for a little while once we arrange everything. \nWhat about you? Wanna come with me? I'll make sure Sultan pays you generously.
Thanks sister, I won't forget your help. Here, take this. I... eh... found this shiny artefact when we were exploring earlier. Consider it payment for your troubles.
